dedupeText: country music album cover aesthetic country music portrait truck interior retro typography outdoor lighting blue palette subject s blue shirt harmonizes with the vehicle s blue frame and the blue typography the warm skin tones and sunset graphic contrast against the dominant cool blue environment the typography is anchored to the lower third overlapping the subject s torso combine a high quality outdoor portrait in a vehicle with a 1970s inspired geometric display logo that uses multi stroke outlines and integrated iconography

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, friendly male portrait set within the interior of a vehicle, featuring a prominent retro-inspired logo with a sunset-themed graphic element and clean sans-serif secondary text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's blue shirt harmonizes with the vehicle's blue frame and the blue typography
The warm skin tones and sunset graphic contrast against the dominant cool blue environment
The typography is anchored to the lower third, overlapping the subject's torso
coreInvariants: Natural daylight filtering through vehicle windows
Shallow depth of field blurring the green foliage background
A multi-line, outlined display typeface for the primary name

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, subject centered horizontally, leaning slightly to the right, filling the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the primary focal point, while the large logo acts as the secondary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face down to the large display logo, then to the subtitle text below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight framing with minimal negative space, primarily found in the blurred background visible through the windows.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Medium blue (shirt, vehicle frame, text outlines)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Natural greens and browns (background foliage and hair)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pink, orange, and yellow gradient (inside the circular graphic)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues and the sunset graphic; natural, realistic saturation in the portrait.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a double-inline or multi-stroke outline effect
Letters are tightly tracked and interconnected by a horizontal baseline bar
The letter 'O' is replaced or filled with a circular graphic element
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' has a long descender that integrates into the baseline bar
The 'O' contains a silhouette of a palm tree and crescent moon against a gradient
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A complex, decorative display font paired with a minimalist, high-tracking sans-serif for clarity.
graphicDevices: Horizontal underline bar connecting the main title
Circular sunset icon with palm tree silhouette

preserve: The horizontal bar connecting the letters
The wide tracking of the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric base suitable for the multi-line outline treatment.
Clean, modern sans-serif for the subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium close-up photo of a smiling man with short brown hair and light stubble, wearing a blue long-sleeve shirt, sitting in the driver's seat of a blue vintage truck. Natural outdoor lighting, blurred green trees in the background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, stylized name in the lower third using a white geometric font with thick blue outlines and a horizontal bar connecting the letters. Replace one circular letter with a sunset gradient icon. Below it, add a subtitle in a clean, cyan-blue sans-serif with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text outlined in blue?
Is there a sunset icon integrated into the text?
Is the subject's shirt color coordinated with the text?

mustAchieve: Balanced color harmony between blue and orange

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the shirt texture
Check that the palm tree silhouette is sharp
Verify the horizontal bar aligns with the bottom of the letters
Confirm the subject's gaze is directed toward the camera
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-quality outdoor portrait in a vehicle with a 1970s-inspired geometric display logo that uses multi-stroke outlines and integrated iconography.
